d: Company Description Ivory Hotels & Resorts is a hospitality brand focused on delivering high-quality guest experiences through excellent service, comfortable accommodations, and thoughtfully designed amenities. The company aims to combine modern standards with local character, providing guests with memorable stays across its portfolio of properties. Ivory Hotels & Resorts emphasizes operational efficiency, strong revenue performance, and continuous improvement to remain competitive in the hospitality market. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, collaborate across departments, and support a culture of professionalism and respect.

Role Description The Director of Revenue Management is a full-time, on-site role based in Jeddah, responsible for leading revenue strategy across Ivory Hotels & Resorts properties. This role oversees pricing, inventory control, and distribution channels to maximize revenue and profitability while maintaining competitive positioning. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing market trends, demand patterns, and performance data; developing and adjusting rate strategies; and coordinating with sales, marketing, and operations teams to align revenue initiatives with business objectives. The Director prepares revenue forecasts and budgets, monitors performance against targets, and provides regular reporting and recommendations to senior leadership. This role also guides and mentors team members, implements revenue management best practices, and ensures systems and processes support data-driven decision-making.
q: Strong revenue management and revenue analysis skills, with proven experience in hotel or resort environments.
Advanced analytical skills and budgeting capabilities to develop forecasts, monitor performance, and optimize profitability.
Sales and commercial acumen, with the ability to collaborate effectively with sales and marketing teams on pricing and promotion strategies.
Proficiency with revenue management systems, PMS, and data analysis tools; strong Excel and reporting skills.
Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, business, finance, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications are an advantage.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior leaders.
Demonstrated leadership experience, including team development, cross-functional collaboration, and change management.
Fluency in English; knowledge of Arabic and familiarity with the Jeddah and wider regional market are beneficial.

Lead and manage refinery engineering, capital projects, modifications, and technical assurance activities to ensure safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operation of refinery assets. Oversee the full project lifecycle from concept development and feasibility studies through design, execution, commissioning, and handover while ensuring compliance with applicable engineering standards, regulatory requirements, and refinery business objectives.

The position will act in accordance with OQ8’s Mission, Vision, Values & Strategies, as well as policies, guidelines and international standards, supported by an IT technology platform, HSE standards, Oman’s government and other legal requirements, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Industrial, or Process Engineering or a related discipline.
Excellent knowledge of reading, written and spoken English (required).

Relevant experience in Engineering, Projects & Technical Services in a similar role or leadership role within Oil & Gas (refining, petrochemical, oil & gas, LNG, or other complex hydrocarbon processing industries).

Proven track record in delivering brownfield projects, plant modifications, debottlenecking initiatives, capacity expansion projects, technology upgrades, and capital investment programs from concept through commissioning and handover.
Extensive experience in engineering design review, technical assurance, process optimization, operational troubleshooting, and Management of Change (MOC) within a refinery environment.

Demonstrated success in managing CAPEX portfolios, project budgets, schedules, resources, contractors, and engineering consultants, ensuring delivery of projects within approved cost, quality, and timeline objectives.

Strong experience supporting refinery operations through technical studies, feasibility assessments, root cause investigations, performance improvement initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
Practical knowledge of FEED, detailed engineering, EPC/EPCM project execution models, commissioning, start-up, and performance testing of refinery facilities and infrastructure.
Experience in applying relevant international engineering standards and industry codes, including API, ASME, NFPA, IEC, ISA, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, manage cross-functional teams, and build effective relationships with technology licensors, contractors, regulatory authorities, and external service providers.

Experience leading organizational improvement initiatives, fostering innovation, developing engineering talent, and implementing best practices that enhance refinery safety, reliability, efficiency, and business performance.
Engineering Standards & Codes (API, ASME, ASTM, IEC, NFPA)
r: Lead refinery engineering activities covering process, mechanical, piping, civil, structural, electrical, instrumentation, automation, and reliability engineering disciplines.
Provide technical support for plant operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
Ensure compliance with refinery engineering standards, international codes, regulatory requirements, and Management of Change (MOC) processes.
Review and approve engineering designs, technical specifications, calculations, drawings, and contractor deliverables.
Identify and implement process improvement, debottlenecking, energy efficiency, emissions reduction, and operational excellence initiatives.
Conduct technical studies, feasibility assessments, and engineering evaluations to support business and operational objectives.
Develop and execute CAPEX projects, brownfield modifications, plant upgrades, debottlenecking projects, reliability improvement initiatives, and strategic investment programs.
Manage project portfolios including scope, schedule, cost, quality, procurement, risks, construction, commissioning, and handover.
Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within approved budgets, and aligned with refinery business objectives.
Lead feasibility studies, Front-End Engineering Design (FEED), detailed engineering, contractor selection, and project execution activities.
Monitor project performance through KPIs, progress reporting, forecasting, and project governance processes.
Lead root cause investigations for significant operational and equipment performance issues.
Support refinery turnaround and shutdown planning by providing engineering expertise and technical evaluations.
Drive technology adoption, digitalization, process optimization, and innovation initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve plant performance, energy utilization, reliability, production capacity, and operating costs.
Ensure technical documentation, engineering records, standards, and drawings remain current and properly controlled.
Manage engineering consultants, EPC contractors, service providers, and vendors.
Review technical bids and support contractor selection processes.
Coordinate engineering and project activities with Operations, Maintenance, HSSE, Supply Chain, and Finance functions.
Liaise with regulatory authorities, technology licensors, engineering consultants, and external stakeholders as required.
Develop and manage engineering and project budgets, CAPEX plans, and long-term investment programs.
Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary engineering and project teams.
Foster a culture of safety, innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Internal: OMT, HSSE, SCM, Finance, Turnaround Teams, Executive Leadership Team, Information Technology / Digital Teams.

External: EPC Contractors, Engineering Consultants, Technology Licensors, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), Regulatory Authorities, Utility Providers, Industry Associations and Technical Networks.
Field operations and office environment. Moderate to intensive computer screen use.
